initiatives.name: Portfolio Restructuring and Strategic Divestments
initiatives.summary: Following portfolio reshaping including the sale of Smiths Interconnect and Smiths Detection, the company has returned £2.6bn to shareholders over five years, including completion of a £500m buyback and a further £1bn return. An additional £1.5bn is expected to be returned by end of calendar year 2027 from Smiths Detection proceeds.
initiatives.investmentSummary: £2.6bn returned over five years; further £1.5bn planned

evidence.title: Divestment of Four Flex-Tek Industrial Businesses
evidence.summary: Smiths Group elected to divest four non-core Flex-Tek industrial businesses as part of ongoing portfolio reshaping. Sales were agreed for three of them for a combined value of £40m, with two completed within FY2026.
evidence.quote: This year, we elected to divest four Flex-Tek industrial businesses, with sales agreed for three of them for a combined value of £40m, with two of the sales completed in FY2026.

evidence.title: Divestiture of John Crane Legacy Asbestos Liabilities
evidence.summary: Smiths Group announced that its US John Crane business will begin a marketing process to divest legacy asbestos liabilities, aiming to remove the liability from the balance sheet, increase free cashflow and available capital, and reduce earnings volatility.
evidence.quote: We are also announcing today that our US John Crane business will begin a marketing process for the divestiture of its legacy asbestos liabilities. If successful, this transaction would remove the asbestos liability from the balance sheet, increase free cashﬂow and available capital and reduce earnings volatility.

evidence.title: Enhanced Shareholder Returns via Buybacks and Divestment Proceeds
evidence.summary: Following portfolio reshaping including the sale of Smiths Interconnect and Smiths Detection, the company has returned £2.6bn to shareholders over five years, including completion of a £500m buyback and a further £1bn return. An additional £1.5bn is expected to be returned by end of calendar year 2027 from Smiths Detection proceeds.
evidence.quote: Enhanced shareholder returns – the portfolio reshaping has enabled enhanced returns to shareholders, with £2.6bn returned in the past ﬁve years. Following the completion of the FY2025 £500m share buyback programme in December, a further £1bn related to the proceeds from the sale of Smiths Interconnect has now been returned. A further £1.5bn is still to be executed in relation to the Smiths Detection proceeds and is expected to be substantially completed by end of calendar year 2027.

initiatives.name: €650m Bond Refinancing
initiatives.summary: Smiths Group issued a €650m bond during the year to refinance an equivalent-sized maturing bond, providing liquidity to meet future financing needs as part of balance sheet strengthening efforts.

evidence.title: €650m Bond Issuance for Refinancing
evidence.summary: Smiths Group issued a €650m bond during the year to refinance an equivalent-sized maturing bond, providing liquidity to meet future financing needs as part of balance sheet strengthening efforts.
evidence.quote: The issuance of a €650m bond during the year, to refinance the equivalent size bond maturing in February 2027, has provided liquidity to meet our future needs.

initiatives.name: DRC Heat Transfer Acquisition for Thermal Solutions
initiatives.summary: Smiths Group completed the acquisition of DRC Heat Transfer in April 2026, contributing to Thermal Solutions growth and revenue from acquisitions in FY2026. This follows prior year acquisitions of Modular Metal, Wattco, and Duc-Pac.

evidence.title: DRC Heat Transfer Acquisition
evidence.summary: Smiths Group completed the acquisition of DRC Heat Transfer in April 2026, contributing to Thermal Solutions growth and revenue from acquisitions in FY2026. This follows prior year acquisitions of Modular Metal, Wattco, and Duc-Pac.
evidence.quote: This included £(32)m of negative foreign exchange translation and a +£49m contribution from the acquisitions of Modular Metal Fabricators, Inc (‘Modular Metal’), Wattco, Inc (‘Wattco’), Duc-Pac Corporation (‘Duc-Pac’) in FY2025 and DRC Heat Transfer (‘DRC’), which completed in April 2026.

initiatives.name: Acceleration Plan and Smiths Excellence Efficiency
initiatives.summary: The company continues to realize benefits from its Acceleration Plan and Smiths Excellence efficiency savings programs, contributing to operating margin improvement and expected to help reach the medium-term target range of 21-23% operating margin in FY2027.

evidence.title: Acceleration Plan and Smiths Excellence Efficiency Programme
evidence.summary: The company continues to realize benefits from its Acceleration Plan and Smiths Excellence efficiency savings programs, contributing to operating margin improvement and expected to help reach the medium-term target range of 21-23% operating margin in FY2027.
evidence.quote: We expect to enter our medium-term target range of 21-23% through operating leverage, achieving the remaining benefits of the Acceleration Plan and continued Smiths Excellence efficiency savings, alongside additional investment into strategic growth initiatives.
